freeze_record.timing: after the locked Phase 2 development result and before any Phase 3 comparative result
freeze_record.reason: separate transition-outcome, causal-history, and sequence-order effects after the current Markov state-transition scorer failed robustly on development Heat

state_conditioning.claim_scope: adding the five current-observation scalars to the same global empirical action-transition summaries did not improve the frozen robust development criterion

transition_outcomes.claim_scope: observed after-state, delta, elapsed-effect, and completion information beyond current state plus action-specific pre-state and availability statistics

causal_history.claim_scope: access to the preceding four learner-observable transitions beyond both the historical Markov scorer and an architecture-identical null-history recurrent control

sequence_order.claim_scope: the order of the same preceding transition multiset, not mere access to additional transition records

seed_policy.formula: base + family_order_index * 10000 + replicate * 100000 + task_index where a task component applies
seed_policy.condition_pairing: all conditions use identical model, probe, search, data-order, family, task and replicate identities
seed_policy.history_shuffle_derivation: SHA-256 of canonical JSON [history_shuffle_base, fold_id, replicate, task_id, phase, trace_or_episode_id, decision_index]; convert the first eight digest bytes to an unsigned integer and select modulo the lexicographically enumerated derangements for window lengths 2-4; never use process-randomized hash()
seed_policy.permutation_map_canonical_bytes: UTF-8 JSON with sort_keys=true, separators=(',', ':'), allow_nan=false, and no trailing newline; the value is an ordered list of records {fold_id, replicate, task_id, phase, trace_or_episode_id, decision_index, input_transition_indices, permuted_transition_indices} sorted lexicographically by the first six identity fields
seed_policy.shuffle_identity: bind each training-view permutation-map SHA-256 to the view and model identities and each search-unit permutation-map SHA-256 to the unit identity

canonical_evidence_reuse.source: the exact 30 Phase 2 optimum-trajectory and affordance evidence artifacts bound by the Phase 2 readiness and result snapshots
canonical_evidence_reuse.trajectory_access: optimum trajectories only; no frontier trajectory or cross-trajectory pairing enters S, T, H0, H4, or H4-shuffled
canonical_evidence_reuse.phase2_anchor_reuse: reuse locked B2 and C/T models and outcomes after exact lineage validation; do not rerun or retune them

anchor_lineage_gate.required_anchor_manifest: before Phase 3 execution, commit an identity-only manifest enumerating the exact 240 B2/C model owners and 5,760 B2/C unit result IDs and byte digests from the descriptor-validated Phase 2 runtime; it must contain no new aggregate or final data
anchor_lineage_gate.T_alias_semantics: T is an analysis-only alias of historical C; it cannot create a new view, model, search, or outcome artifact
anchor_lineage_gate.parity_checks: fail unless every T consumer resolves to the exact historical C view/model/unit ID and digest and the recomputed representation tensor, logits, candidate-generation SHA-256, typed outcome fields, and result bytes match; any mismatch forbids anchor reuse and Phase 3 execution

conditions.representation: 49-channel global empirical action-transition summary without current state
five current-state scalars plus the full 49-channel empirical action-transition summary
conditions.bitwise_parity_requirement: the T representation, model, logits, generation, and selected Phase 2 outcomes must remain identical to historical C

representation.coverage_treatment: retained as an action-availability/sampling-support statistic and reported diagnostically; it is not treated as an observed candidate outcome
representation.claim_limit: tests explicit measured candidate-outcome channels conditional on the same probe visitation and coverage data; it does not claim that prior trajectory state visitation or coverage is causally independent of earlier actions

representation.history: a fixed all-zero 12-channel null token sequence whose length exactly equals min(4, the number of preceding transitions available to H4) for that same decision
representation.reset: recompute the null window from zero GRU state independently for every decision; never carry a persistent hidden state

representation.history: up to the four immediately preceding learner-observable 12-channel transitions from the same episode, oldest to newest
representation.causality: no current selected action, future transition, evaluator field, optimum threshold, task/family ID, or hidden state
representation.training_reset: empty recurrent state at each reference trajectory start
representation.decision_evaluation: at every decision, rebuild the preceding length-at-most-four window and run it from zero GRU state; never carry a persistent hidden state between decisions
representation.search_reset: each candidate episode starts with an empty window; heldout probe transitions never enter candidate history

conditions.representation: identical to H4 except order is independently permuted within each causal preceding-history window

control_semantics.permutation: seeded index derangement for every window of length 2-4; no index remains in its original position
control_semantics.decision_evaluation: recompute each permuted length-at-most-four causal window from zero GRU state independently for every decision
control_semantics.training_and_search: apply the frozen deterministic shuffle at both training and candidate generation
control_semantics.effective_change_definition: the ordered 12-channel transition tensor differs byte-for-byte after permutation; a deranged index map over duplicate transition vectors may be map-nonidentity but tensor-ineffective
control_semantics.sequence_claim_coverage_gate: at least 0.80 of length-2-or-more windows must have an effective tensor-order change separately in training and heldout search; otherwise sequence-order claims are forbidden without changing the run

artifact_sharing_and_cost_ownership.evidence_identity: reuse the exact Phase 2 canonical evidence key and digest for each fold and replicate
artifact_sharing_and_cost_ownership.view_identity: condition_id, evidence key and digest, representation schema and transformation SHA-256, data-order seed, and training permutation-map SHA-256 where applicable
artifact_sharing_and_cost_ownership.model_identity: condition_id, fold_id, replicate, training_tuple_id, view identity, model seed, learning rate, epochs, optimizer, and architecture/capacity spec SHA-256
artifact_sharing_and_cost_ownership.temperature_reuse: one model owner is reused unchanged by the three search-temperature consumers of the same condition, fold, replicate, and training_tuple_id
artifact_sharing_and_cost_ownership.selected_tuple_cost_scope: sum exactly 30 unique model-owner reports for the selected condition and training_tuple_id: six folds times five replicates; never multiply by eight heldout tasks or three temperatures

fixed_training_and_search.examples: one causal decision example per optimum transition; identical identities, labels, count, order, and batches across S, T, H0, H4, and H4-shuffled
fixed_training_and_search.oracle_timing: after the complete fixed candidate batch and independent replay

capacity_matching.same_data_controls: S and T use the same MLP exactly; H0, H4, and H4-shuffled are architecture-identical and execute the same recurrent-step count per matched decision; all learned conditions use identical examples, labels, optimizer, update count, batches, inference and search budgets
capacity_matching.strong_B2_floor: B2 retains the complete Phase 2 candidate grid, examples, optimizer updates, probes, candidate episodes, interaction budget, and selected result; it is never capacity-, training-, or search-restricted to favor H4

selection_rule.scope: independently select one numeric tuple within each new S, H0, H4, and H4-shuffled condition; reuse the independently locked B2 and T selections; no cross-condition elimination
steps: retain tuples within 0.05 absolute of that condition's best minimum-family success rate
minimize macro-average family median restricted interactions
minimize summed unique model-owner optimizer steps, then forward passes, then recurrent steps
choose ascending numeric tuple (learning_rate, training_epochs, search_temperature)
selection_rule.family_aggregation: compute within family first, then equal-weight families
selection_rule.restricted_interactions: paid heldout probes plus candidate-generation actions through the first post-hoc exact candidate; failures use 2049

claim_and_advancement_rule.robust_primary_gain: a selected left-to-right condition must improve minimum-family success by more than 0.05 absolute
claim_and_advancement_rule.within_tolerance: differences of at most 0.05 cannot support a robust success claim; frozen median tie-breaks may support only an efficiency statement
claim_and_advancement_rule.transition_claim: requires selected T to beat selected S under robust_primary_gain
claim_and_advancement_rule.history_access_claim: requires selected H4 to beat both selected T and selected H0 under robust_primary_gain
claim_and_advancement_rule.sequence_order_claim: requires selected H4 to beat selected H4-shuffled under robust_primary_gain and the shuffled control to pass its predeclared effective-change coverage gate
claim_and_advancement_rule.H4_advancement_to_paired_objectives: requires the dual-control history-access gate and the sequence-order gate, no development-family success drop greater than 0.05 versus selected B2, and H4 minimum-family success no more than 0.05 below selected B2
claim_and_advancement_rule.failed_gate: retain B2 as the strong reference, preserve the negative result, diagnose on development only, and do not unlock final families

diagnostics.cannot_change: candidate eligibility, selection rule, capacity rule, budgets, seeds, history length, architecture, or claim thresholds
